name: higgs_mass_bare
tier: Tier 3 bare lambda = 1/8 packing ansatz on an added broken-vacuum completion + Tier 3 physical m_H pending TP-E 1-loop closure
app_psc_precision_str: −1.69% gap (pred − obs; 19.2σ vs PDG unc; not attributed to a computed correction)

extra.v_convention: v_GCT from the absolute Higgs-VEV pipeline (top-quark-row convention); measured v would give 123.11 GeV
extra.closure_condition: GCT-native one-loop/spectral-action correction must account for the −1.69% (pred − obs) gap without importing the SM correction as a fit.
extra.radiative_framing: The −1.69% gap (pred − obs = −2.11 GeV) is not attributed to a computed correction. lambda_bare = 1/8 lies near the SM MS-bar value lambda(m_t) ~ 0.126, not near the value the SM runs to at M_GUT, and the scale at which 1/8 applies is not derived (V3 Ch05 5.2.3). A GCT-native 1-loop calculation (modified beta functions of App GRF with phason loop contributions, bundled with the QLQCD-1L closure programme) is the closure target. This verifier records the bare relation; it registers no prediction.
extra.tier_1_closure_path: TP-E (roadmap A.3): full 1-loop spectral-action computation in the GCT framework, replacing the unattributed gap with a first-principles GCT-specific value. Requires App GRF beta functions + Connes spectral action evaluated on the N=144 cage, following QLQCD-1L closure.
